title: Memphis
summary: Memphis stood at an important junction between the Nile Valley and Delta. UNESCO describes its traditional foundation around 3000 BCE and its later role as an administrative and religious centre.

claims.text: Memphis stood at an important junction between the Nile Valley and Delta. UNESCO describes its traditional foundation around 3000 BCE and its later role as an administrative and religious centre.
Traditional foundation chronology is explicitly approximate and needs further archaeological corroboration.

The foundation date is a conventional attribution, not an excavated day of creation. Looking at administrative centres alongside settlements elsewhere helps separate state formation from the much longer history of human occupation.
